title: feat(types): a page list-view node is judged in its properties bag — data / type — and objectName / viewType are refused by name (objectui#12670)
body:
Fixes #12670
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Ruling: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22444, comment `6100463199` (ruling C). Scope: triage `6216264566` on objectui#12670, option A under C as it stands. Claim: comment `6216538732`, re-stated as `6218329226` for the merge round. Written by the dispatched os-dev of the `domain:ui` seat 3, session `session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`. The renderer half of the same ruling is PR objectui#12668 (objectui#12099); it landed on `main` as `5c0846e`, and this branch merged `main` after it (merge commit `badde80`), so the landing head carries both halves.

## What changes

- **The authored page arm** (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`). `ListViewBlockSchema` is the `list-view` arm of `AnyComponentSchema`, in `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema` beside the other authored block arms. `ListViewSchema` left `ObjectQLComponentSchema`, the way `ObjectMapSchema`, `ObjectGridSchema` and `ObjectChartSchema` left it, and stays exported, unchanged, as the `ListView` component's props.
- **The bag** (`ListViewPropsBag`, module-private). The installed `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.2 has no `ComponentPropsMap['list-view']` row, so the bag is built the way `object-chart`'s is: the flat `ListViewSchema` mirror's own members, by reference, each the same schema object (`z.looseObject(ListViewSchema.shape)` less the node-level keys). Those members are the spec list view's own (`specFieldsExcept` over the spec's `ListViewSchema`) plus objectui's overlay, so one list view has one set of property names wherever it is embedded. Three members differ, each the ruling's: `type` is the list kind, the spec's own view-kind enum (default stripped); `objectName` and `viewType` are refused by name (`aliasKeyRefusal`), naming `properties.data` and `properties.type`.
- **The spec's list view checks run in the bag**, by reference: `checkListViewCalendarVisualization` (as on the flat mirror) and `checkListViewChartBinding`, which the flat mirror cannot attach because its kind is `viewType`. objectui's own dataset-chart filter refusal (objectui#10327) is read in the bag too, with the bag's `type` as the kind.
- **The node.** `type: 'list-view'` + `NODE_ENVELOPE` + `flatPropRefusals` over the bag (every list view member written flat is refused by name toward `properties.KEY`; a retired member, `objectName` / `viewType`, keeps its own retirement there, so the message is the same flat or in the bag) + the mirror's `dataSource` binding by reference + the five `handlerKeyRefusal` runtime slots `ListView` reads, spelled as the mirror spells them + the objectui#9256 `body` / `children` refusals.
- **The record source.** `requireRecordSource('list-view', ['data'], 'properties')`: `properties.data`, or the node's non-empty `dataSource.object` (the registration is `elementDataSourceBlock`-wrapped). Otherwise `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `properties.data`, naming both.
- **TypeScript** (`authoring-nodes.ts`, `index.ts`). `ListViewBlockNode = ObjectQLPublicBlockNodeOf('list-view')`, exported, its bag closed by `ClosedBag`. It joins `AuthoringNode` through `ObjectQLPublicBlockNode`. The TypeScript `ListViewSchema` and both TypeScript unions (`AnySchema`, `ObjectQLComponentSchema`) are unchanged; one doc comment on the latter now counts six zod arms.
- **Docs.** `packages/types/src/zod/README.md`: the `ListViewSchema` section names the page arm, with the ruled node as a JSON example, and the ObjectQL public block section describes `ListViewBlockSchema`.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/12670-list-view-page-face.md`, `@object-ui/types: minor`, with the breaking part for page nodes in the old spelling written out (objectui AGENTS.md §9). It names `ObjectQLComponentSchema`'s lost `list-view` arm in the precedent's spelling, with a BREAKING line for code that parses with it directly.
- **plugin-list README rider** (`packages/plugin-list/README.md`). The page fence's `doc-json: fragment` declaration is deleted, so `check:doc-json` judges the fence whole and accepts it. The paragraph that said `objectui validate` does not judge the page spelling now says what it judges. The kind stays in prose.
- **types README** (`packages/types/README.md`). The by-name list of ObjectQL block node types gains `ListViewBlockNode`, `ObjectPivotBlockNode` and `EmbeddableFormBlockNode`, so it matches the 11 arms of `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema`.

## Contract evidence (Clause-②)

**What `objectui validate` / `StrictAnyComponentSchema` and `safeValidateSchema` answer**, measured on the BUILT `dist` of `@object-ui/types`, at `main` `dcd1041` and at this branch:

| probe node | before, tolerant | before, strict | after, tolerant | after, strict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ruled: `properties: { data: { provider: 'object', object }, type: 'kanban', kanban }` | refused: `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `objectName` | refused: `unrecognized_keys` (`properties`) + `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` | **accepted** | **accepted** |
| flat `objectName` | accepted | accepted | refused: `invalid_type` at `objectName` (`objectName` → `properties.data`) + `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `properties.data` | same |
| `properties.objectName` | refused: `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `objectName` | refused: `unrecognized_keys` + `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` | refused: `invalid_type` at `properties.objectName` (`objectName` → `properties.data`) + `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `properties.data` | same |
| `properties.viewType` beside `properties.data` | refused: `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `objectName` | refused: `unrecognized_keys` + `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` | refused: `invalid_type` at `properties.viewType` (`viewType` → `properties.type`) | same |
| flat `viewType` beside the ruled bag | refused: `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `objectName` | refused: `unrecognized_keys` + `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` | refused: `invalid_type` at `viewType` (`viewType` → `properties.type`) | same |
| no record source: `properties: { columns }` | refused: `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `objectName` | refused: `unrecognized_keys` + `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` | refused: `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` at `properties.data` | same |
| `dataSource: { object }` alone | accepted | accepted | accepted | accepted |
| the retired node: flat `objectName` + `viewType` | accepted | accepted | refused: `invalid_type` at `objectName` and at `viewType` + `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` | same |

So the accept set WIDENS by the ruled page spelling and NARROWS by the retired one, flat or in the bag, and by every other list view prop written flat (the spec's own page component already refuses those as unrecognized keys: measured on `PageComponentSchema` for `objectName`, `viewType`, `columns`, `name`). `objectui validate` / `objectui check` judge with `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (`validateAuthoredDocument`); the CLI's own pins (`packages/cli/src/__tests__/`, 29 files) are green on this build.

**What the built `.d.ts` gain or lose** (base build at `dcd1041` against this branch's build; the same 78 `.d.ts` files on both sides):

- `zod/objectql.zod.d.ts`: gains `ListViewBlockSchema`. `ObjectQLComponentSchemaInferred`'s arms go from `object-view`, `object-tree`, `object-calendar`, `object-kanban`, `object-gallery`, `object-data-table`, `list-view` to the first six; `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchemaInferred` gains `list-view` as its eleventh. Every other declaration there, `ListViewSchema` included, is unchanged once comments are stripped and union member order is ignored.
- `zod/index.zod.d.ts`: re-exports `ListViewBlockSchema`; the inferred types of `validateSchema` / `safeValidateSchema` / the unions now carry the bag arm for `list-view`.
- `authoring-nodes.d.ts`: gains `ListViewBlockNode`; `index.d.ts` re-exports it. `objectql.d.ts`: one doc comment.
- Ten other `zod/*.d.ts` differ byte-wise only by the order the compiler printed union members and by where it re-attached JSDoc comments (a normalised comparison, union members sorted, says identical).
- Reverse check through a consumer that resolves `@object-ui/types` from `dist` (`@object-ui/plugin-list`'s `tsconfig.json` replaces the root `paths`): a scratch file typing `{ type: 'list-view', properties: { objectName: 'deal' } }` as `ListViewBlockNode` failed `tsc` at that key (`TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`), the ruled node beside it compiled; the file was removed and `git status` read clean.

## The PM's mechanism hypotheses, measured

1. **Holds, with the construct chosen from the no-row precedent.** At `dcd1041` `ListViewSchema` is `BaseSchema` + spec fields + `type: z.literal('list-view')`, `dataSource`, `objectName`, `viewType`, closed by `requireRecordSource('list-view', ['objectName'])`, no `properties`. The authored arms are wired as described (`ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema`; `ObjectQLPublicBlockNodeOf`), and the new arm is wired the same way. Where it deviates: there is no row, so the bag follows `ObjectChartBlockSchema` (the flat mirror's members) rather than `ObjectMapBlockSchema` (a row), and the flat refusals use the shared `flatPropRefusals` (as `object-grid` and `object-pivot` do) rather than an own map.
2. **No row.** `ComponentPropsMap` at 18.0.0-next.2 has 59 rows, none `list-view`. The spec publishes `ListViewSchema` (51 members, strict, `columns` required, a kanban block's `columns` required, two object-level checks: the calendar visualization and the chart binding) and `ObjectListViewSchema`. The bag is the flat mirror's members by reference (the `object-chart` precedent). ⛔ Not the spec's `ListViewSchema` verbatim: it requires `columns`, so the ruled node would be refused, which is what ruling C's declined option A says of that row.
3. **Holds.** On `main` the `list-view` registration's renderer is `ListViewBlock = elementDataSourceBlock(…)`, so a non-empty `dataSource.object` counts, on the shared `dataSourceSuppliesObject`.
4. **Census** below.
5. **TS fallout: none found.** Both TypeScript unions keep `ListViewSchema`, so no value typed as either changes; `ObjectQLPublicBlockNode` / `AuthoringNode` only gain a member. Non-test code narrowing a node on the `list-view` literal: 0 (`git grep`). Type-checked against the rebuilt `dist`: `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-view`, `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/cli`, 4 of 4 green, plus `@object-ui/types` itself (all three legs). The app-shell and console closures (the whole workspace) are left to CI's `Type Check`.

## Census: what the union judges as a `list-view` node (hypothesis 4)

Instrument: `git grep` for a `list-view` literal (185 files outside changelogs), narrowed to files that also name a union face (`safeValidateSchema`, `validateSchema`, `AnyComponentSchema`, `StrictAnyComponentSchema`, …), then a run of `packages/types` against the new arm to find every pin the move reddens. Positive control: `spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`, known to hand a flat list view to `safeValidateSchema` (hit, and red before the re-spell).

- **Page nodes in fixtures and docs** (judged by the union): 3 JSON fences, `content/docs/guide/data-source.md`, `content/docs/utilities/data-objectstack.mdx` and `packages/plugin-list/README.md`'s page-binding section, each `{ "type": "list-view", "dataSource": { … } }`. Accepted before and after (`check:doc-json` green); nothing to convert. Since the merge, `packages/plugin-list/README.md`'s page fence (PR objectui#12668's) is accepted too, and judged whole.
- **`ListView` component schemas** (not judged by the union): the four non-test `type: 'list-view'` literals, re-measured on `dcd1041`: `InterfaceListPage.tsx` and `ObjectDataPage.tsx` in `@object-ui/app-shell`, `ObjectView.tsx` in `@object-ui/plugin-view`, a doc comment in `objectql.zod.ts`. Left as they are.
- **Tests pinning the retired spelling at a published door**: 16 `packages/types` files went red on the move (135 tests), and two `plugin-list` files hand a flat list view to `safeValidateSchema`. Each kept its intent and was re-pointed, not deleted: the door legs now judge the page spelling of the same list view (a test-only helper, `packages/types/src/__tests__/list-view-page-node.ts`, re-spells it and reads issue paths relative to the bag), while each mirror leg still judges `ListViewSchema`. The census pins count the new arm: union arms (`objectql-union-arms-7363`, `registered-type-arms-10859-b2`), the flat-prop population (`flat-props-refusal-10872`, with the five runtime slots recorded as the arm's own refusals), `responsiveStyles` (`public-block-responsive-styles-10872`), `grouping` (`grouping-field-padded-refused-7347`), the mirror ledger (`zod-mirror-parity`), the import boundary (`imported-defaults-8317`: `checkListViewChartBinding` is a chained spec refinement) and the bag carriers (`authoring-nodes-bag-carriers-11468`). In `list-view-dataset-chart-filter-refusal-10327` two controls author a `chart` list with no dataset binding: the component props still accept them, and the page door now refuses them with the spec's own `checkListViewChartBinding` issue (asserted against the spec's parse), never at the view filter.

## Tests

- New pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/list-view-properties-bag-12670.test.ts`, both faces: the ruled node, a bound node, an inline-rows node, at a child slot; every spec list kind in the bag's `type`, and the registry key, a retired kind and a misspelling refused; no default authored; `objectName` / `viewType`, flat and in the bag, refused at their own paths with the FROM → TO and the document shape; the record source (four refused shapes, two sources); the bag's members by reference; the spec's two checks with the spec's own issue; the flat refusals, the runtime slots, the content channels; and that `ListViewSchema` still judges the component props. Type-level: the arm's and the bag's input types, and the TypeScript `ListViewSchema` unchanged.
- At `fadb698` (the head): `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/`: `Test Files  384 passed (384)` / `Tests  10494 passed (10494)` (lock verdict `command-exit 0`). The re-spelled cross-package pins plus the CLI suite (`plugin-list` ×2, `plugin-view` ×2, `app-shell` `ViewPreview.optionsFold-7928`, `plugin-map` `bareMapKeyRetired-10393`, `plugin-grid` `groupingNullEntry-7217`, `scripts/__tests__/check-handler-key-read-sites.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/__tests__/`): `Test Files  37 passed (37)` / `Tests  524 passed (524)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (three legs; the test leg's `--listFiles` includes the new pin and the helper): exit 0 at `fadb698`.
- Ablations, each through `ablation-replace.mjs`, direction predicted before the run, restore proven by blob hash against `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - drop the bag's `objectName` refusal: predicted and observed 3 red (`properties.objectName`, flat `objectName`, the no-fallback case), 594 green across the new pin and `flat-props-refusal-10872`;
  - arm the public-block union with `ListViewSchema` again in place of `ListViewBlockSchema`: predicted and observed red on every page-door leg (94 red across the new pin, `list-view-options-bag-6152` and `spec-object-refinements-7715`), the 118 mirror-leg tests green.

**At `5bb1b1d` (the merged head, after a `@object-ui/types` build):** `packages/types/` plus `plugin-list`'s 8355, 8365 and `ListViewBlock.pageCarrierSpelling-12099` pins and `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-json-fences.test.ts` → `Test Files 389 passed (389)` / `Tests 10591 passed (10591)`. `@object-ui/types` type-check exit 0. The changeset and README claims were probed on the built face: `ObjectQLComponentSchema.safeParse` refuses a `list-view` node on the discriminator; the README fence is accepted; `type: board` is refused at `properties.type`. The records above are the earlier `fadb698` ones.

## Acceptance notes

- **Rider done: `packages/plugin-list/README.md`.** At `badde80`, before the edit, `check:doc-json` exited 1 with the stale-fragment-marker verdict ("delete the marker"). At `5bb1b1d` it exits 0: 246 accepted, 0 refused.
- **Landing order — met.** Triage `6216264566` set it: land with or right after PR objectui#12668. objectui#12668 is on `main` (`5c0846e`), and this branch merged it.
- **`data` presence.** The record-source rule counts `properties.data` by presence (`!== undefined`), the maintainer ruling recorded 2026-09-02 for every arm. So `data: { provider: 'object', object: '' }` passes the face, and after objectui#12668 it draws the "no object named" hint, as `objectName: ''` did on the flat arm. Not changed here: it is the shared rule's question, not this arm's. Seat answer `6218339393`: A.
- **The legacy aliases ride along.** The bag carries every member `ListView` reads today (`fields`, `filters`, the `show*` flags, `densityMode`, the `options` bag), because they are the mirror's members. When objectstack-ai/objectstack#22444 adds the spec row at lint tier, it judges those by its own reading.
